units.source_text: 常陆亲王家的小姐末摘花正是其中之一人。

en.t: The lady Suetsumuhana of Prince Hitachi's household was one of them.

units.source_text: 自从父王死后，她就成了无依无靠的孤苦之身，生涯甚是凄凉。

en.t: After her royal father died, she was left lonely and without anyone to rely on, and her life became deeply desolate.

units.source_text: 后来想不到结识了源氏公子，蒙他源源不绝地周济照拂。

en.t: Later, unexpectedly, she became acquainted with Lord Genji and received his continuous support and care.

units.source_text: 在尊荣富厚的公子看来，这算不得一回事，只是小小情意。

en.t: To the honored and wealthy lord, this was nothing much, only a small gesture of kindness.

units.source_text: 但在贫困的末摘花看来，就好比大空中的繁星映在一只水盆里，只觉光彩甚多，从此可以安乐度日了。

en.t: But to the impoverished Suetsumuhana, it was like the stars of the vast sky reflected in a basin of water; she felt surrounded by radiance and thought she could live peacefully from then on.

units.source_text: 不料正在此时，公子忽遭大难，忧生厌世，心绪缭乱，除了情缘特别深厚之人以外，一概都已忘却。

en.t: Just then, however, the lord suddenly met with a great calamity; weary of life and the world, and with his heart in turmoil, he forgot everyone except those to whom he was especially deeply bound.

units.source_text: 远赴须磨之后，亦复音信全无。

en.t: After he went far away to Suma, there was still no word from him at all.

units.source_text: 末摘花多年受恩之余，暂时之间还可啼啼哭哭地苦度光阴，但年月渐久，生涯便潦倒了。

en.t: After years of receiving his kindness, Suetsumuhana could for a while pass the days in hardship, weeping as she went, but as the months and years stretched on, her life fell into ruin.

units.source_text: 几个老年侍女都悲愤愁叹，相与告道：“可怜呵，真是前世不修今世苦！

en.t: Several elderly gentlewomen lamented in grief and indignation, saying to one another, "How pitiful; truly, suffering in this life comes from failing to cultivate merit in a former one!

units.source_text: 年来忽然交运，竟像神佛出现，承蒙大慈大悲源氏公子的照拂，我等正在庆幸她能获如此福报哩。

en.t: In recent years her fortune had suddenly turned, as if gods and buddhas had appeared, and she had received the care of the greatly compassionate Lord Genji; we were just rejoicing that she had gained such blessed fortune.

units.source_text: 为官含冤受罪，原是世间常有之事。

en.t: For an official to suffer under a false accusation is, after all, a common thing in the world.

units.source_text: 但我们这位小姐别无依靠，这光景真可悲啊！”

en.t: But our lady has no one else to depend on; this situation is truly heartbreaking!"

units.source_text: 在从前孤苦伶仃的年代，虽然寒酸无比，过惯了也便因循度日。

en.t: In the earlier years of loneliness and hardship, although life was extremely poor and shabby, once she had grown used to it she could simply drift through the days.

units.source_text: 但在略尝幸福滋味之后再遭贫困，反而觉得痛苦不堪了。

en.t: But after tasting even a little happiness, to fall into poverty again felt all the more unbearably painful.
For this reason, all the gentlewomen grieved and lamented.

units.source_text: 当年多少有所用心而自然而然地围集在她身边的侍女，此时也都逐渐散去。

en.t: The gentlewomen who in those days had gathered naturally around her, each with their own small hopes, now gradually drifted away as well.

units.source_text: 无家可归的侍女中，有的患病而死。

en.t: Among the gentlewomen who had no homes to return to, some fell ill and died.

units.source_text: 日月既久，上下人数竟寥若晨星了。

en.t: As the days and months went by, the number of people high and low in the household became as sparse as stars at dawn.
